title: Send them a memory
detail: Right now, from wherever you are — one thing you remember about them that they do not know you remember.

title: Three things
detail: Tell each other three things you are grateful for about the other. Out loud, not typed.

title: One hour, no phones
detail: Both phones in another room. One hour. That is the whole challenge.

title: Cook their favourite
detail: Make the thing they would pick if they could pick anything. If you cannot cook it, get it.

title: Write it by hand
detail: A note, on paper, left somewhere they will find it without being told.

title: Ask something you have never asked
detail: A real question. Not about logistics.

title: Learn one thing they love
detail: Pick something they are into that you are not, and spend twenty minutes actually understanding it.

title: Go back somewhere
detail: Somewhere that meant something. It does not have to be far.

title: Swap playlists
detail: Five songs each, and you both have to actually listen to all five.

title: One photo, today
detail: Not a selfie. Something you saw that made you think of them.

title: Clear one thing up
detail: Something small that has been sitting there. Say it, finish it, move on.

title: Plan a day for them
detail: Their whole day, their taste, not yours. You just run it.

title: Be specific
detail: One compliment, and it has to be about something they did, not how they look.

title: Take one off them
detail: The job they hate most. Do it without saying you are going to.

title: Twenty minutes, no screens, one topic
detail: Pick something neither of you has an opinion on yet and work it out together.

title: Go through old photos
detail: Together, out loud, with the stories.

title: Say the thing you have been not saying
detail: Kindly. But say it.

title: Change one morning
detail: Do tomorrow morning differently. Anything, as long as it is not the usual.

title: Ask about their people
detail: Ask properly about someone in their life you have never really asked about.

title: A day with no complaints
detail: Not about each other, not about anything. Harder than it sounds.

title: Teach them something
detail: Anything you know and they do not. Twenty minutes.

title: Do the first date again
detail: Same place if you can, same order if you remember it.

title: Write to next year
detail: One letter each, to the two of you a year from now. Seal them.

title: Twenty seconds
detail: Next time you hug, do not let go for twenty seconds. Count.
